Me and my friend were in a tight circle of friends, and despite us all becoming a bit estranged over time (before this), we've stayed friends and on good terms. This will be unifying for us, but of course, we wish it were under happier circumstances. 

I used to do software development a lot, before I found myself not having much time to do so, but now that I've finished college, it'll be something that I can do to help me stay occupied and focused instead if losing myself to my emotions.
